releases.title: Compact internship cards and clearer summaries
changes: Internship cards show the company, role, exact pay, city and state.
Short TLDR notes put known program dates and key eligibility in the final bullet.
Internships use varied theme paper colors, with more of the strongest accent. Job salary bands stay unchanged.

releases.title: The first internships are on the board
changes: Browse 46 source-checked internships with exact pay, eligibility and application dates.
A separate internship inventory keeps unavailable and held listings out of the board while preserving their review records.
Clearer empty states and program-pay labels, with current internship status checked before hosted listings load.

releases.title: Internship pay and eligibility up front
changes: Internship cards keep exact hourly, monthly and program pay, with the full duties and eligibility in a readable note.
Accepting applications and upcoming programs have separate counts and actions. Announced dates do not automatically open applications.
Internship sharing stays on the internship board, and keyboard focus stays visible inside job details.

releases.title: Preferences without leaving the board
changes: Your preferences now opens as a compact paper pop-up, with a light background blur and clear syncing, saved and retry states.
Optional analytics count preference save, clear and skip actions and not-a-fit responses without collecting typed answers or job identities for those actions.

releases.title: Clearer sign-in and a coffee break
changes: The welcome-back card shows Google with Sign In while signed out, and returns to its close button when signed in.
Replaced the Original theme’s push-up figure with a coffee-break drawing on the board and in the style guide.

releases.title: A welcome that remembers this browser
changes: Dismiss the Version 2 welcome once without signing in; automatic appearances are capped at two, and What’s new remains available.
Open Portfolio Graded inside the welcome for a tier-list example and a coming-soon link.
More Themes uses the same white note paper as the other updates.
Release numbering now pauses before 2.5.0 for a decision on the version format.

releases.title: A board that gets to know your interests
changes: Added optional account preferences, personal job hiding and returning-visitor suggestions on enabled previews.
Opened an internship section with separate review, eligibility and compensation details; its first listings are still being checked.
Added six illustrated lessons about experience during college and expanded drawings across the advice notes.

releases.title: A calmer application routine
changes: Kept Monday clear and moved the calendar cross-out to Friday, alongside Saturday and Sunday.
Reworded the advice as a suggested routine, with a reminder to apply when ready and respect deadlines.

releases.title: The Original stick figures are back
changes: Restored the earlier Original stick figures and matching examples in the style guide.
Kept the other seven themes and gave the first figure room below the board links.

releases.title: Advice notes in the style guide
changes: Open sample advice notes and see how the paper, handwriting and calls to action fit together.
Find guidance for clear promotional labels, everyday wording, photos and the site name, with contents links for quicker browsing.

releases.title: Texture, character and theme feedback
changes: Added texture guides and three matching drawings for every theme, shared with the job board.
Separated optional theme likes and dislikes from theme selections in the analytics dashboard.
Made theme feedback easier to dismiss and kept it out of job detail windows.

releases.title: Quieter notices and a familiar homepage
changes: Replaced the automatic privacy form with a short notice and optional detailed choices.
Restored graduation-photo enlargement within the homepage, without a popup.
Updated the mobile bookmark prompt and made its instructions easier to read.

releases.title: A clearer way back
changes: Shortened the welcome detail action to go back.

releases.title: Your interests, your choices
changes: Optional personalized ordering follows the career fields and roles you explore, with higher disclosed pay among comparable jobs.
Separate analytics and recommendation controls, a history reset, and clearer privacy explanations.
A private owner dashboard summarizes measured activity and answers supported questions.

releases.title: Every theme, with a clearer welcome
changes: Explore all eight themes in the style guide, now linked from Version History.
A roomier Version 2 welcome puts the tracker first and gives each feature one clear way back.
Optional Google sign-in in the application feedback note keeps your unanswered question through sign-in.

releases.title: Back to the notebook
changes: Shared warm yellow, handwritten welcome and suggestion notes, a visual style guide, and a shorter mobile bookmark reminder.
Featured job cards follow salary bands, with clearer action text.

releases.title: Meet Version 2
changes: A welcome on your first Jobs visit introduces advice, themes, Google sync and Tracker, plus a Portfolio Graded preview.
A tighter homepage, Apply to Jobs beside Nic’s signature, and easier access to Bookmark and Suggest Jobs.
Version history is available from the founder note, board footer and welcome.
Six additional verified job URL variants now group into their original postings.

releases.title: The new board
changes: Saved jobs and applications sync across devices with Google sign-in.
Clearer navigation and mobile controls.
One card per recognized job posting, with existing saved links preserved.
Search and filter across all 14 job categories.
A roomier desktop homepage, clearer bookmark shortcut and clickable graduation photo.
Restored founder notes and clearer Sign In and Signed In labels.
Suggest Jobs sends links to a private review inbox before any publishing decision.
Version history now lives beside the homepage footer links.
